## File: huggingface_trl/trl/experimental/gkd/gkd_trainer.py

Prompts

```
['create a GKDTrainer instance to perform generalized knowledge distillation between a student and teacher language model', 'compute the generalized Jensen-Shannon Divergence loss between student and teacher model logits', 'train a student language model using on-policy distillation from a teacher model with self-generated mistakes', 'generate on-policy responses from a student or teacher model for knowledge distillation training', 'review the GKDTrainer class for knowledge distillation with on-policy learning and self-generated mistakes']
```

Usage

```
{'create_gkd_trainer': 'create a GKDTrainer instance to perform generalized knowledge distillation between a student and teacher language model', 'compute_gkd_loss': 'compute the generalized Jensen-Shannon Divergence loss between student and teacher model logits', 'train_gkd_model': 'train a student language model using on-policy distillation from a teacher model with self-generated mistakes', 'generate_on_policy_responses': 'generate on-policy responses from a student or teacher model for knowledge distillation training', 'review_gkd_trainer': 'review the GKDTrainer class for knowledge distillation with on-policy learning and self-generated mistakes'}
```
